purpose: Bounded recovery for the observed macOS DMG hdiutil EBUSY failure; no underlying busy resource is attributed.

observed_failure.head: 153a1eb6aa996f77aa213936d4946584e13d53b5
observed_failure.evidence: Bounded watcher receipt only; original log body remained sealed.

repair.retry: Only exit code 1 plus an exact stderr line; 3 attempts maximum, delays 100 ms and 200 ms.
repair.candidates: Fresh owned temporary directories under checked canonical output; cleanup limited to these candidates.
repair.staging: Reuse the same signed source stage and creation argv, changing only the candidate output path.
repair.publication: Preserve existing final DMG until successful creation of a nonempty ordinary candidate; publish by rename.
repair.downstream: DMG signing, notarization, stapling, hdiutil verification, and checksum sequence remain unchanged.

qualification.warning_policy: Standard host debug/default features, rustflags []; no -D warnings override
matrix: Exact busy partial image then success
Same diagnostic with exit code 2 is immediate
invariants: Existing final preserved through every creation attempt and every failed result
Signed stage bytes and unrelated output preserved
Owned partial candidates and temporary directories removed
Successful final contains complete new image bytes

limits: Portable Windows CPU fixture with fake outcomes and disposable files only. No real hdiutil/macOS, CAD GUI, GPU, model, session or inbox calls. No existing passing case rerun. Real macOS artifact acceptance requires current-head hosted packaging CI.

integration_review.review: Root independently reviewed exact retry policy, output ownership, original failure and source-fenced one-case result. Incoming app-only option and auditable packaging remain preserved; the hdiutil create path and ordinary filesystem guards used by the CPU fixture are unchanged.
integration_review.source_hash_representation: Raw probe checkout bytes; the incoming LF attributes may change materialized bytes in other checkouts without changing the qualified helper logic.
